domain: multilateral development bank operations / project lifecycle panel
prediction_question: At the board-approval instant of an African Development Bank Group (AfDB) operation, using only the at-approval attributes AfDB publishes in its IATI activity files (country, sector, financing instrument, commitment, planned span, era), will the operation ultimately be CANCELLED (activity-status 5) rather than COMPLETED (activity-status 3)?
prediction_time: The instant the operation enters AfDB's published record at approval: activity-date type 1 (planned start), observed within ~1 day of MapAfrica's displayed 'Approval Date' (P-KE-KF0-013: UI 23 Sept 2026 vs API planned_start 2026-09-24; a bounded construction sample must pin this offset). All features are at-approval attributes; the terminal status is observed only years later at the current coverage end (registry files re-published in full, so the current vintage is the observation frame - a current-vintage retrospective task, not an operational historical claim).
target_definition: Binary: terminal activity-status = Cancelled (IATI code 5) vs Completed (code 3) for operations whose outcome window has closed. Label source column: activity-status in AfDB's IATI XML (excludable by construction - it ships only as the label). Statuses 1 (Approved, 383) and 2 (Ongoing, 987) are right-censored and never scored; eligibility must be defined from information available at the instant (approval date + planned end + censoring margin), never from eventual status.

split_strategy: Temporal split on approval year. Proposed (positive counts measured from the bounded full-population cancelled fetch of 2026-11-04, 230 rows): train approvals <=2000 (136 cancelled positives), eval 2001-2010 (36), holdout 2011-2023 (58). Negatives (completed 4,400) are thousands per window but per-window denominators and eligibility accounting are unmeasured - the exact per-window class count over the terminal population is the FIRST construction measurement on the worker, with acceptance criteria recorded before scoring. Positives cluster by country (measured: 49 distinct countries, top DRC 15 / Cote d'Ivoire 10 / Liberia 9 / Tunisia 9 / Angola 9 of 230; 29 rows multinational) and by approval year - per-window clustered counts required at construction.

measurements.mapafrica_stats_2026_11_04: Publisher's own aggregate (browser same-origin fetch /api/v15/stats?currency=xdr): activities 6,000; activity_status {1: 383, 2: 987, 3: 4400, 5: 230}; 55 countries, 18 sector groups, 58 sectors, 16 ADF cycles, 5 regions; total commitments (non-gov view) 142,427,078,206.7 XDR.
measurements.registry_inventory_2026_11_04: package_search?fq=organization:afdb&rows=100: 57 datasets, license_id cc-by on 57/57, sum(activity_count extras)=5,188 (afdb-org has no count), largest files afdb-multinational 781, afdb-nonsovereign 402, afdb-morocco 175, afdb-tunisia 166, afdb-tanzania 131. Evidence: probe/out/africa_tick_b12.json.
measurements.datastore_crosscheck_2026_11_04: datastore.codeforiati.org (community index of the same registry files): 5,187 activities for reporting-org=XM-DAC-46002; activity-status=3 -> 3,896; activity-status=5 -> 191; start-date<1985 -> 610; start-date<2000 -> 1,759; 2010<start-date<2020 -> 1,439. DISCREPANCY recorded honestly: MapAfrica reports 230 cancelled / 4,400 completed while the datastore indexes 191 / 3,896 - MapAfrica's internal database appears to carry more rows than the published IATI files; construction MUST define the population from the registry XML only (the publisher's own bulk instrument) and reconcile this gap as a design input, never mix channels.
measurements.sao_tome_file_schema_2026_11_04: afdb-saotome XML (42 activities, 1,145,985 bytes, one anonymous GET): activity-status mix {3: 32, 2: 7, 1: 3}; activity-date types 1,2,3 on 42/42 and type 4 (actual end) on exactly the 32 completed - label derivable from published dates; planned_start != actual_start on 42/42 (approval vs effectiveness are distinct); overrun check on the 32 completed: actual_end > planned_end on 4/32 (12.5% of this one-country sample) - recorded as evidence that a schedule-overrun target would be revision-contaminated (planned_end in the current vintage is the revised end), NOT as a population count.
measurements.xml_field_inventory_2026_11_04: Per-activity fields available at approval in the registry XML: iati-identifier, title, recipient-country, sector (vocabulary 1), activity-date types 1-3, default-flow-type (10=ODA), default-finance-type (421/110 on 35/42 in the sample), default-tied-status (5=untied), conditions attached, budget items with AfDB-specific codes, participating organisations (2,073 distinct across the bank per MapAfrica stats). Post-approval / label-source fields excluded from features: activity-date type 4 (actual end), activity-status, transaction histories (2,442 transaction elements in the sample file carrying afdb:finance-type-id), total_disbursements. No explicit board-approval-date element exists in the XML; the type-1 date is the instant proxy (see prediction_time).
measurements.extraction_cost_measured_2026_11_04: Coordinator (browser, Cloudflare-cleared): 3 activities pages (100 rows each, ~40 KB/page) + 1 stats call + 1 codelists attempt. Coordinator (plain HTTP): registry package_search 90,702 B + package_show 1,625 B + one country XML 1,145,985 B in one GET (~3 s); datastore count queries 4.3-99 KB each, 6 queries. Bulk estimate (NOT a count): 57 XML files, 5,188 activities at ~27 KB/activity measured on the one file -> ~140 MB total, worker-scale. PREREQUISITE: afdb.org static-file paths answered this coordinator anonymously (dynamic afdb.org pages 403 plain clients), but worker-side (Hetzner) reachability is untested - the dws.gov.za lesson; the first worker job must measure it.
measurements.known_event_fixtures: Positives (label 1, measured in the cancelled fetch): P-LR-B00-005 Liberia, approved 1969-07-24 (earliest cancelled, sector 32110, sovereign, UA 1,350,000); P-SD-FF0-001 Sudan, approved 2019-12-18, actual start 2020-03-05, planned end 2025-12-31, sector 23230, sovereign, UA 29,020,000. Negative (label 0, measured in the afdb-saotome XML): 46002-P-ST-K00-012, planned start 2013-06-17, actual end 2015-12-31 before planned end 2016-06-30, status 3 (Completed).
measurements.novelty_search_2026_11_04: Web searches found no published, scored or ML-ready benchmark for AfDB operation outcomes: nearest prior art is a Nature Energy 2020 ML study predicting realization of PLANNED POWER PLANTS in Africa (different population - all power plants, not AfDB operations), MOPAN institutional assessment reports (descriptive), and an unrelated HuggingFace IATI mirror of Malaysia aid flows (country-level aggregates, no outcome task). The WB-family comparators on this bench (wb-ieg-project-outcome, wb-loan-disbursement-completion) were dropped on measured no-headroom over identity/rate priors at the Board-approval instant - this candidate's differentiation must be measured against that precedent, not assumed (see next_action).

novelty_check.ours: A scored, temporally split AfDB operation-cancellation benchmark built from the publisher's own CC BY IATI activity files: at-approval attributes only, 1969-2023 deep history with positives in every split window, censoring-aware eligibility, current-vintage contract declared
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.

review: Five contracts at investigating: (1) Redistribution SUPPORTED (class A, two publisher instruments, 57/57 registry datasets cc-by). (2) Prediction timing PARTIALLY SUPPORTED - the instant is stateable (approval, activity-date type 1) and features are at-approval attributes in a fully republished file, but the current-vintage-only posture must be declared (no historical snapshots promised) and the type-1-vs-approval-date offset needs a bounded sample; UNRESOLVED items recorded in prediction_time. (3) Target SUPPORTED as derivable-and-excludable (activity-status is the label source; censoring rule stated; the MapAfrica-vs-registry count gap must be reconciled at construction). (4) Split capacity PARTIALLY SUPPORTED - positives measured in every proposed window (136/36/58) but per-window denominators and clustered counts are unmeasured (worker pass; the first construction measurement). (5) Contribution UNRESOLVED pending check-novelty.py and the pre-registered family-risk test: two WB at-approval tasks on this bench died on rate-table/identity priors, so the reference triad (global / country / sector-x-decade cancellation rates) is the mandatory first scored comparison and a pre-registered drop condition, not an afterthought.
next_action: Discovery-owned order for the next session(s): (1) record the novelty verdict with scripts/check-novelty.py (queries: 'AfDB project cancellation prediction', 'African Development Bank project success machine learning', 'IATI project outcome prediction dataset', 'multilateral development bank project cancellation dataset'); (2) worker-side reachability + bounded extraction test of the 57 afdb.org XML URLs (the dws.gov.za lesson: coordinator success does not prove worker access); if afdb.org blocks the worker, fall back to registry resource URLs / datastore; (3) full-panel worker pass to measure the unmeasured numbers: terminal population (status 3+5) per approval-year window with both classes, per-window clustered counts (country x year), the eligibility accounting under the censoring rule, and the reconciliation of MapAfrica 230 cancelled vs datastore 191; (4) pin the instant: bounded sample of type-1 dates vs MapAfrica displayed approval dates (P-KE-KF0-013 one-day offset) and the codelists status vocabulary via the browser (/api/v15/codelists is Cloudflare-gated); (5) PRE-REGISTER the family-risk test before any model: reference triad from train only (global rate, trailing country rate, trailing sector-x-decade rate) on the identical eval rows - if the triad's strongest member is not beaten by a meaningful margin, this is the third measured instance of the WB at-approval family defect and the candidate drops with the evidence; (6) cross-row design: if any trailing-rate feature ships, anti-join design + gate-1.5 reverse-history probes per the za-statsa/ibama precedents; (7) only then advance to construction -> full-worker qualification -> exact-byte acceptance -> reference triad -> reporting, in the standing order. Construction must not start while the packaged-candidate rule blocks it.
